Current_Defect: Header logo and search icon padding can cause slight horizontal jitter on very small screens (<=360px)
User_Impact: Subtle layout shift during scroll on ultra-compact mobile devices
Recommended_Solution: Add overflow-x: hidden on bkp-masthead-bar and adjust padding to 8px on max-width 360px
Verification_Criteria: Zero horizontal scrollbar at 320px 360px 390px in Chrome DevTools

Current_Defect: Category navigation horizontal scrollbar lacks visual right fade indicator
User_Impact: Users may not realize there are additional categories (region/realtime) hidden to the right
Recommended_Solution: Add CSS mask-image linear gradient to right edge of scrollable nav container
Verification_Criteria: Right edge visually indicates overflow content with smooth fade

Current_Defect: Article body images loaded without explicit aspect-ratio could cause minor Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
User_Impact: Layout jumps slightly while high-resolution image is downloading
Recommended_Solution: Add CSS aspect-ratio: 16 / 9 and background-color: #f3f4f6 placeholder to .article-body-figure
Verification_Criteria: Lighthouse CLS score <= 0.05 on 4G simulated mobile network

Current_Defect: Reading progress track bar is fixed at top but has z-index collision with utility bar when scrolling fast
User_Impact: Progress bar temporarily obscured behind header during rapid scroll
Recommended_Solution: Set z-index: 1001 on .reading-progress-track to stay above utility header
Verification_Criteria: Progress bar continuously visible at very top of viewport on all scroll offsets

Current_Defect: In dark mode some input forms in search dropdown retained light background contrast on initial render
User_Impact: Harsh white flash in search input when dark mode is activated
Recommended_Solution: Ensure input[type="search"] has background: var(--bg-surface) and color: var(--text-primary) across all themes
Verification_Criteria: Dark mode inputs have dark charcoal background with high contrast white text

Current_Defect: Empty bookmark state icon and message was slightly misaligned vertically
User_Impact: Empty state looks sparse and unpolished when user has not saved any articles
Recommended_Solution: Center empty state card with generous padding (64px) and add "Explore News" CTA button
Verification_Criteria: Clean centered card with bookmark icon and functional button navigating to /news

Current_Defect: Password visibility toggle icon was missing
User_Impact: User cannot verify entered password characters during login
Recommended_Solution: Add eyeball toggle SVG button inside password input container
Verification_Criteria: Clicking icon toggles input type between password and text

Current_Defect: Uploaded image thumbnails in editor gallery had fixed width that wrapped unevenly on 1366px screens
User_Impact: Gallery grid displayed 3 items on row 1 and 1 item on row 2 leaving awkward white space
column11: Fluid responsive grid adapting smoothly from 1024px to 1920px viewports

Current_Defect: Bottom navigation active tab indicator had low color contrast against light gray background
User_Impact: Hard to distinguish which section is currently active under bright sunlight
Recommended_Solution: Change active tab icon color to brand navy (#060D81) with 3px solid top border indicator
Verification_Criteria: Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards

Current_Defect: Textarea for guest article pitch lacked character counter feedback on mobile
User_Impact: Contributor cannot easily gauge if their draft satisfies length requirements
Recommended_Solution: Add live word and character count indicator beneath contributor pitch textarea
Verification_Criteria: Live counter increments synchronously as user types in textarea

Current_Defect: Form submission feedback alert was standard browser alert() instead of custom toast
User_Impact: Inconsistent UI feel and interrupts user flow
Recommended_Solution: Replace window.alert with in-page animated toast alert (green success / red error)
Verification_Criteria: Smooth toast notification appears in bottom-right corner for 4 seconds

Current_Defect: Masthead editor list was rendered in 2 uneven columns on 1200px viewports
User_Impact: Visual hierarchy between Editor-in-Chief and Desk Editors was slightly ambiguous
Recommended_Solution: Restructure into distinct hierarchical cards (Executive Board -> Senior Desks -> Bureau Correspondents)
Verification_Criteria: Clean visual hierarchy with badges distinguishing editorial roles

Current_Defect: Country chips horizontal scroll row could feel sticky on iOS Safari inertia scrolling
User_Impact: Noticeable lag when swiping rapidly across country tags on iPhone
Recommended_Solution: Add -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch and scroll-snap-type: x mandatory to container
Verification_Criteria: Silky smooth 60fps momentum swipe across country chips on iOS Safari

Current_Defect: Affiliate CTA card needed clearer disclosure tag to comply with FTC / KFTC guidelines
User_Impact: Commercial partnership must be clearly signaled to maintain journalistic trust
Recommended_Solution: Add badge "Sponsored Recommendation / 제휴 안내" above partner booking links
Verification_Criteria: Clear visual disclosure badge visible on all device viewports
